steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each factor is matched to its evidence and to the method. A factor with no evidence is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Factor with no evidence
findings.fix: Attach the evidence for the factor

findings.title: Factor not in the method
findings.fix: Remove the factor or change the method

findings.title: Score outside the method's range
findings.fix: Correct the score to the range

outcome.notChecked: Whether the method suits the organisation.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] factor-effort.md:12  Factor with no evidence.
       Fix: Attach the evidence for the factor.
[medium] factor-conditions.md:19  Factor not in the method.
       Fix: Remove the factor or change the method.
[low] scores.csv:26  Score outside the method's range.
       Fix: Correct the score to the range.
Not checked: Whether the method suits the organisation.
pros: Checks a factor with no evidence, a score outside the method's range, and a factor that is not in the method.
cons: Not checked: Whether the method suits the organisation.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-job-evaluation skill on the records for this review.
